concerns.location: plan.md:§ Constitution Check table, II. Verified Accuracy
concerns.text: The plan relies on an internally‑bundled placeholder CSV (`data/raw/hea_placeholder.csv`) because no verified open‑source HEA dataset is available. This violates Constitution Principle II (Verified Accuracy) and means the study cannot legitimately evaluate the predictive power of ML for real HEA compositions. A verified, publicly accessible dataset (e.g., Materials Project or AFLOW Parquet files) must be used, or the research scope must be revised to reflect a demonstration on synthetic data only.
